schemas.title: EpisodeDefinition
schemas.description: Immutable specification of a simulation episode, freezing dataset, calendar, policies, rules, and initial state.

schemas.title: EpisodeRun
schemas.description: Lifecycle state and execution record of an episode run referencing an immutable episode definition.

schemas.title: PolicyDefinition
schemas.description: Declaration of a decision policy family and its metadata.

schemas.title: PolicyVersion
schemas.description: Immutable specification of a frozen policy version with requirements, hyperparameters, and tolerances.

schemas.title: DatasetSnapshotManifest
schemas.description: Immutable manifest of a frozen dataset snapshot with source metadata, checksums, and series definitions.

schemas.title: ObservationRecord
schemas.description: Immutable single observation record with explicit event time, knowledge time, revision number, and domain payload.

schemas.title: RoundRecord
schemas.description: Immutable execution record of a single simulation round with timestamps, observation hashes, policy outcomes, and state Merkle hash.

schemas.title: ProposedDecision
schemas.description: Domain-neutral decision proposal emitted by a policy at a given round knowledge cutoff.

schemas.title: DecisionOutcome
schemas.description: Validation and acceptance outcome of a proposed decision evaluated against frozen episode rules.

schemas.title: TransitionRecord
schemas.description: Immutable record of state changes, resource deltas, and incurred costs applied to a policy virtual account.

schemas.title: VirtualAccountState
schemas.description: Snapshot of an isolated policy virtual account holding generic resources, valuation, and cumulative costs at a round boundary.

schemas.title: MetricRecord
schemas.description: Calculated performance, risk, and execution metrics for a policy over a round or an entire episode.

schemas.title: OpteesCallReceipt
schemas.description: Immutable receipt recording an invocation of an Optees capability with pinned contract versions, request/response hashes, and redacted transport details.

schemas.title: ReplayReport
schemas.description: Report of an episode replay run comparing state hashes and recording overall replay fidelity.

schemas.title: DivergenceReport
schemas.description: Immutable record of an observed divergence between original run state and re-executed state, classified into frozen categories.

schemas.title: AcquisitionReceipt
schemas.description: Immutable receipt recording raw artifact acquisition, publisher checksum verification, and linkage to a normalized dataset snapshot manifest.
